crossRefs.note: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

translations.web: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
translations.bsb: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.
translations.kjv: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns
translations.asv: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be; and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of one piece with it.
